items.text: Bears ruled Caleb Williams OUT for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent questionable (cleared steps to practice, not fully cleared protocol).
items.why: Official Saturday ruling; Bagent progress but Q.
items.implication: Bagent or other potential starter; impacts Bears pass catchers.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for second straight week vs Colts. ETR confirms OUT.
items.why: Did not practice; official ruling Friday/Saturday.
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes targeted, 28% team target share last week without Collins; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL; Rapoport reports not expected to play Sunday vs Broncos. Davante Adams has shown he can carry the load.
items.why: ETR injury list and McVay comments; Rapoport video confirmation not expected.
items.implication: Adams primary WR1 opportunity spike in routes/targets.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua historically; big games prior (8-195-2).

items.text: Jayden Daniels officially ruled OUT; Marcus Mariota to start. Rapoport notes positive longer-term news, not IR.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin historical 25% target share with Mariota but tough SEA matchup.
items.conflict: Berry hates McLaurin this week vs SEA despite Mariota history.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe). Steelers RB coach: Jaylen Warren will lead the group. Levitan expects checkdown spam given vertical game struggles; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Official out; coach comments on rotation.
items.implication: Warren clear lead back with high checkdown upside.
items.opportunity: Warren lead snaps/touches; projected in despite Q (shoulder).

items.text: Colts placed Alec Pierce on IR; elevated Nick Westbrook-Ikhine. ETR lists OUT.
items.implication: Downs target share jump (36% after Pierce exit prior); more perimeter routes.

items.text: Levitan projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: ETR projections context; limited practice but expected.
items.implication: Start them if active; Warren lead already locked.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey listed IN/off injury report and good to go vs Rams. Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter confirms off report.
items.implication: Committee likely; reverse prior Coleman beneficiary.
items.conflict: Berry still likes Coleman long-term as Broncos RB to own.

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN for Sunday.
items.implication: Nabers full role expected; Etienne active but limited prior usage.
items.conflict: Berry hates Etienne (low snap/third-down share even with Kamara).

items.text: Davante Adams targeted on 42% of 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram. Prior misses: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
items.why: Historical route/target data with Nacua out.
items.implication: Strong WR1 upside if Nacua sits.
items.opportunity: Elevated target rate and production history.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sims-based ceiling; projections live and updating for news.
items.implication: Elite smash potential in favorable spot.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.

Berry LOVES Chase Brown (@PIT, 20+ touches/15% targets, RB7 util); Chris Olave (vs LV, double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% tgt share w/o Collins, IND 4th-most TE yds).
items.why: Usage and matchup facts from Love/Hate.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Schultz waiver/stream boost.
items.opportunity: Brown volume; Olave air yards; Schultz targets.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne (vs LV, only 49% RB touches/38% 3rd-down snaps); Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX, 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, tough run D); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA, fewest WR fantasy pts allowed, low team total).
items.implication: Sit or fade; Henderson gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead.
items.conflict: Etienne IN per ETR but low opportunity.
